items.title: MängudeÖÖ conference is taking place already on the 16th October!

items.title: A new opportunity for game development and creative tech teams in Estonia
items.body:
A new opportunity for game development and creative tech teams in Estonia. Tehnopol’s Film and Multimedia Accelerator is looking for early-stage teams developing technology-based solutions for the games, film, media, entertainment and creative sectors.

EST: IDA Hubi kiirendiprogramm annab teadmised ja tööriistad, et arendada oma lahendus toimivaks iduettevõtteks, jõuda kiiremini maksvate klientideni ja liikuda lähemale investeeringu kaasamisele.

6-kuulise programmi jooksul saad:
• kogenud võtmementori, kes toetab ja suunab sinu ettevõtte arengut
• teadmised 7-osalisest praktilisest koolituste sarjast, mis annab tugeva baasi kasvuks
• ekspertmentorite toe just nendes valdkondades, kus sul on kõige rohkem küsimusi
• toetava kogukonna ja kutseid põnevatele üritustele
• võimaluse esineda investoritele siis, kui oled selleks valmis
• kasutada avatud kontorit Tallinnas või IDA Hubis

Osalemiseks ootame, et sinu lahendus:
• looks innovatsiooni filmi- ja multimeediavaldkonda
• oleks vähemalt MVP või prototüübi tasemel
• sul oleks pühendunud tiim
• ärimudel oleks skaleeritav ehk kasvupotentsiaaliga

Loe lisa ja kandideeri: https://lnkd.in/dsD4_NfU
Kandideerimine on avatud kuni 18. oktoobrini.

ENG: The IDA Hub acceleration program gives you the knowledge and tools to turn your solution into a viable company, reach paying customers faster, and get closer to securing investment.

During the 6-month program, you will:
• Work with an experienced lead mentor who will support and guide your company’s growth
• Gain a strong foundation through a 7-part practical training series
• Receive expert support in the areas where you have the most questions
• Join a supportive community and get invitations to exciting events
• Pitch to investors when you are ready
• Use the open office space in Tallinn or at IDA Hub

To join, we expect that your solution:
• Brings innovation to the film and multimedia sector
• Has at least an MVP or prototype
• Has a committed team
• Has a scalable business model with growth potential

Learn more and apply: https://lnkd.in/dtRvnWv9
Applications are open until October 18.

items.title: Tipilan 2026 has wrapped and we have the new reining challengers in League of Legends — Ööbik
items.body:
Tipilan 2026 has wrapped and we have the new reining challengers in League of Legends — Ööbik.

Congratulations to the runner ups Eesti kärbes and LOMiks!

Thank you to all the teams that came out to entertain. Cheers to the audience at home and on site. Until the next Tipilan!

Photos by Kaur Kantsik and Arthur Sepp.

items.title: Tipilan 2026 has concluded and the new elites in CS2 town are Chromeheads
items.body:
Tipilan 2026 has concluded and the new elites in CS2 town are Chromeheads.

Congratulations to the runner ups GENESIS and LAAZERI!

Applause to all the teams that came out to compete. Big shoutout to the audience on site and at home. See you on the next Tipilan!

Photos by Arthur Sepp.

items.title: Nordic Business Breakfast @ Gamescom is coming again!
items.body:
If you’re heading to gamescom, come start your day with a relaxed breakfast, good conversations, and great company from across the Nordic gaming ecosystem!

A perfect chance to meet new people, catch up with familiar faces, and connect before the busy Gamescom day begins.

Come enjoy a nice breakfast with us and join the Nordic community. The event has limited capacity, so if you’d like to join, send a private message and ask for the registration code.
https://lnkd.in/defWZqRK

See you in Cologne!

items.title: TipiLAN GameDev Expo is coming back in 2026!
items.body:
Last year, the TipiLAN expo area was legendary, with 35 local games, amazing educational partners, and the first-ever EGG Awards celebrating unreleased Estonian indie games.

Now we’re calling Estonian game devs again!

If you're working on a game, whether it’s a polished product, a playable demo, a student project, or still a work-in-progress, we’d love to showcase it at TipiLAN 2026.

The expo takes place on 11–12 September at TalTech. Submit your game here (deadline 2 August): https://lnkd.in/ehBpn9hx

Join the server here: https://lnkd.in/ez4nhQjr

Let’s make TipiLAN 2026 another amazing showcase of Estonian game development!
